items.title: Kim Kardashian Shimmers in Custom Sequin Gucci Gown for LACMA Gala 2026 Red Carpet
items.summary: WWD red-carpet coverage of Kim Kardashian wearing a bespoke sequin Gucci gown to the 2026 LACMA Art+Film Gala in Los Angeles on November 7; Parker Posey also wore Gucci at the same event. Descriptive celebrity-dressing write-up without an independent evaluative verdict, so treated as activation coverage under the sentiment rubric.

items.title: Gucci Sets Up New Business Units' Organization
items.summary: WWD business-news report that Gucci restructured into new business units meant to support creative director Demna's output while splitting fashion-collection development into two distinct flows; industry veterans Monica Ulmi and Marco Semeghini joined as senior advisers. Factual organizational reporting, no evaluative framing, tagged negative_earnings-adjacent context (restructuring amid ongoing sales decline) but coded neutral for framing.

items.title: Mariah Carey Stars in Gucci's 2026 Christmas Campaign
items.summary: Descriptive coverage of Gucci's 'Gucci Gift' holiday campaign starring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine, built around her 1994 song and new Butterfly collection (Starlet and GG Marmont bags, horsebit loafers, Ace sneakers). Pure activation write-up (who/what/where), no outlet verdict; still generating active secondary discussion through this week (see items 004-006).

items.title: Fans Are 'Disappointed' Over Mariah Carey's 'Depressing' Gucci Holiday Campaign & 'Boring' Styling
items.summary: Compiles negative social-media reaction to the Gucci x Mariah Carey holiday film: commenters call it cold, outdated and emotionless, with one comparing the styling to 'if JCPenney was trying to be luxury' and another saying the mood resembled a horror anthology. Independent consumer-reaction reporting (not brand-supplied), carried forward from earlier in the week because the thread is still active in new coverage today.

items.title: Gucci Gift with Mariah Carey
items.summary: Official Gucci YouTube upload of the Mariah Carey holiday film; included to anchor the SNS side of the ongoing reaction wave. Page did not expose public view/like/comment counts at time of check, so engagement fields are null; brand-owned post coded neutral (activation discount).

items.title: Gucci.com Trustpilot reviews: customer-service and quality complaints
items.summary: Aggregate consumer reviews on Trustpilot's Gucci storefront page skew negative: recurring complaints about dismissive customer service, slow/unhelpful returns handling, and quality failures (a ring breaking within two weeks, Interlocking-G rubber hardware abrading skin). Genuine unprompted consumer community complaint channel, not brand-controlled; this is the critical-angle counterweight to the holiday-campaign/gala activation coverage.

items.title: PurseForum Gucci subforum: quality-concerns and shopping-experience threads active this month
items.summary: PurseForum's dedicated Gucci subforum carries live threads this month including 'Gucci quality concerns' and 'Appreciation for Gucci quality,' alongside shopping-experience and authentication discussion -- the two threads together illustrate the genuinely split community sentiment (some praising construction, others flagging hardware/leather defects). Direct community forum access (not press aggregation); engagement counts not exposed without a logged-in session.

items.title: Gucci Price Cuts Break Luxury's Biggest Taboo. Louis Vuitton Isn't Following
items.summary: Business analysis (Forbes, syndicated via Yahoo Finance) of Gucci quietly cutting prices on bags, shoes and ready-to-wear -- e.g. the Padlock top-handle bag down roughly 30% in France -- after 13 consecutive quarters of falling sales, with CEO Luca de Meo conceding 'price increases that were possible a few years ago are no longer feasible.' Contrasts with Louis Vuitton's refusal to follow; independent critical-trade analysis, not Gucci-sourced, and notes shoppers found the cuts via search/social before any official announcement, which fueled some buyer resentment among full-price purchasers.

items.title: TikTok discover page: 'is Gucci on boycott list' search interest
items.summary: An active TikTok discover/search topic asking whether Gucci is subject to a boycott, reflecting lingering consumer-advocacy chatter tied to pricing and labor/ethics discourse in the luxury sector generally; specific video content and counts were not accessible without login, so this is logged as a search-interest signal only, magnitude damped per bot/fandom-trap guidance given the lack of verifiable original-poster context.

items.title: Gucci Brings Latest Retail Concept to the U.K. Via Harrods
items.summary: WWD report that Gucci's relocated Harrods womenswear boutique (opened to the public November 13) is the first U.K. rollout of the new 'store show' retail concept previewed at the Milan spring 2027 show, with Italian Renaissance-palazzo and midcentury Milanese design cues; it is only the second global site after the Paris flagship. EU-market news included here only as regional context for the parallel North American store-network strategy discussion (NA store count reductions under Kering's closure plan); primary item lives in EU pool.

items.title: Is Gucci Still Worth Buying in 2026?
items.summary: Consumer-advice blog weighing Gucci resale value retention (roughly 55-70% of retail for excellent-condition pieces, middle tier versus Hermes/Chanel) against recent price cuts, concluding Gucci is 'moderate' for resale liquidity but not an appreciating asset, with pieces depreciating 30-45% immediately after purchase. Independent quantified consumer-value judgment distinct from brand messaging; kept at mixed/neutral-leaning-negative framing per the dominant-thesis rule.
